# Balcony herb garden

Tomatoes in containers need a large pot, regular feeding and a stake before they get heavy. Herbs on a balcony need at least five hours of direct sun and a pot with drainage holes. Mulch keeps the soil cool and slows evaporation during hot weeks. Group plants with similar water needs together so one schedule fits the whole shelf. A strong spray of water knocks aphids off; ladybirds finish the job if you let them.

## Steps

- Succulents want a gritty mix with pumice or perlite so water drains within minutes.
- Tomatoes in containers need a large pot, regular feeding and a stake before they get heavy.
- Yellow lower leaves often mean overwatering rather than a lack of nutrients.
